# AelitaOS App Integration Placeholder

This directory will document or host future reviewed AelitaOS app integration entries.

Planned app integration order:

1. include Aelita-Fon as a preloaded app first;
2. promote to system app second after review;
3. consider `priv-app` only after explicit future review.

Alpha 0.1 boundaries:

- no privileged permissions in Alpha 0.1;
- no debug APK in a ROM release candidate;
- release signing is required later;
- no APK files are committed in this PR.
